# Awesome Agent Runtimes

A curated map of software that owns AI-agent execution, state, serving, or isolation.
Generated: 2026-08-21T15:01:00+00:00
Source: https://github.com/beejmaxx/awesome-agent-runtimes
Methodology: https://github.com/beejmaxx/awesome-agent-runtimes/blob/main/METHODOLOGY.md

## Persistent agent runtimes

Complete environments for long-lived assistants and autonomous workers.

- Agent Zero (https://github.com/agent0ai/agent-zero): General-purpose autonomous agent runtime with an interactive UI, subordinate agents, and executable tools. [18,921 stars; local, self-hosted, multi-agent, code-execution, memory]
- AIOS (https://github.com/agiresearch/AIOS): Research agent operating-system kernel for scheduling LLM calls, memory, storage, and tools. [6,261 stars; local, library, scheduler, memory, research]
- AutoGPT (https://github.com/Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT): Platform for creating, deploying, and continuously running autonomous agents. [186,710 stars; self-hosted, managed, continuous, builder, marketplace]
- ElizaOS (https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza): Agent operating system with persistent identities, multi-agent coordination, and a plugin ecosystem. [19,113 stars; local, self-hosted, multi-agent, plugins, memory]
- Hermes Agent (https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent): Persistent agent runtime with learned skills, cross-session memory, schedules, messaging gateways, and subagents. [233,848 stars; local, self-hosted, self-improving, skills, scheduler, multi-agent]
- Letta (https://github.com/letta-ai/letta): Stateful agent server centered on persistent memory, context management, and long-lived identities. [24,331 stars; self-hosted, managed, memory, server, stateful]
- OpenClaw (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw): Personal agent runtime with messaging channels, schedules, memory, skills, and tool execution. [387,025 stars; local, self-hosted, personal-agent, scheduler, tools]

## Coding agent runtimes

Agent harnesses that own the software-engineering loop, workspace, tools, and sessions.

- Aider (https://github.com/Aider-AI/aider): Terminal coding-agent runtime built around repository maps, editable worktrees, and Git-native sessions. [48,382 stars; local, coding, terminal, git]
- Cline (https://github.com/cline/cline): Autonomous coding-agent runtime available as an IDE extension, CLI, and embeddable SDK. [66,598 stars; local, library, coding, IDE, human-in-the-loop]
- Codex (https://github.com/openai/codex): Local coding-agent runtime and CLI with sandboxed command execution, approvals, and automation modes. [110,805 stars; local, coding, sandbox, terminal]
- Crush (https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush): Terminal coding-agent runtime with multi-model support, language-server integration, and extensible tools. [27,554 stars; local, coding, terminal, LSP]
- Gemini CLI (https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli): Terminal agent runtime for coding and general automation with tools, extensions, and MCP support. [106,598 stars; local, coding, terminal, MCP]
- Goose (https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose): Local extensible agent runtime that automates engineering tasks through MCP tools. [53,151 stars; local, coding, MCP, desktop]
- Open Interpreter (https://github.com/openinterpreter/openinterpreter): Local coding-agent runtime for open models with computer tools and executable workflows. [68,097 stars; local, coding, computer-use, local-models]
- OpenCode (https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode): Open-source coding-agent runtime for terminal, desktop, and IDE clients with parallel sessions. [199,829 stars; local, self-hosted, coding, client-server, multi-session]
- OpenHands (https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands): Software-development agent platform with a runtime for executing tools in isolated workspaces. [84,702 stars; local, self-hosted, managed, coding, sandbox, multi-agent]
- Pi (https://github.com/earendil-works/pi): Extensible coding-agent toolkit and CLI with persistent sessions, a unified model API, and UI libraries. [94,928 stars; local, library, coding, extensible, sessions]
- Roo Code (https://github.com/RooCodeInc/Roo-Code): IDE coding-agent runtime with specialized modes, tool use, and multi-agent orchestration. [archived; 24,329 stars; local, coding, IDE, multi-agent]
- SWE-agent (https://github.com/SWE-agent/SWE-agent): Research-backed software-engineering agent runtime for resolving repository issues in controlled environments. [20,095 stars; local, self-hosted, coding, research, benchmark]

## Agent and workflow runtimes

Libraries and kernels that own the agent loop, state transitions, or multi-agent coordination.

- AgentScope (https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope): Developer framework for tool-using and multi-agent applications with runtime services. [29,150 stars; library, self-hosted, multi-agent, tools, distributed]
- Agno (https://github.com/agno-agi/agno): Python framework and AgentOS runtime for building, serving, and monitoring agent systems. [41,822 stars; library, self-hosted, managed, multi-agent, memory, observability]
- AutoGen (https://github.com/microsoft/autogen): Event-driven framework for conversational, tool-using, and multi-agent applications. [60,559 stars; library, self-hosted, multi-agent, event-driven, tools]
- CAMEL (https://github.com/camel-ai/camel): Multi-agent framework and research platform for agent societies, tools, memory, and task execution. [17,614 stars; library, self-hosted, multi-agent, research, memory]
- CrewAI (https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI): Role-based multi-agent runtime for coordinating crews and event-driven flows. [57,425 stars; library, self-hosted, managed, multi-agent, flows, observability]
- Dapr Agents (https://github.com/dapr/dapr-agents): Agent framework built on Dapr actors and durable workflows for resilient distributed execution. [740 stars; library, self-hosted, durable, actors, distributed]
- Google Agent Development Kit (https://github.com/google/adk-python): Code-first agent framework with sessions, tools, evaluation, and local or managed runtime options. [21,216 stars; library, local, managed, multi-agent, evaluation, tools]
- LangGraph (https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph): Graph-based runtime for stateful, durable, and human-in-the-loop agent workflows. [40,175 stars; library, self-hosted, managed, durable, human-in-the-loop, graph]
- Mastra (https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra): TypeScript agent framework with workflows, memory, evaluation, and observability. [27,351 stars; library, self-hosted, managed, workflows, memory, observability]
- Microsoft Agent Framework (https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework): Microsoft framework for building agents and graph workflows with middleware and state management. [13,024 stars; library, self-hosted, managed, workflows, multi-agent, middleware]
- OpenAI Agents SDK (https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python): Lightweight Python runtime for agent loops, handoffs, guardrails, sessions, and tracing. [28,830 stars; library, handoffs, guardrails, tracing]
- Pydantic AI (https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai): Typed Python agent framework with tools, durable execution integrations, graphs, and evaluation. [19,430 stars; library, self-hosted, typed, durable, evaluation]

## Serving and control planes

Systems for packaging, deploying, exposing, and operating agent workloads.

- Dify (https://github.com/langgenius/dify): Visual platform for building and operating agentic applications, workflows, and model services. [153,122 stars; self-hosted, managed, low-code, workflows, observability]
- Docker Agent (https://github.com/docker/docker-agent): Declarative runtime and CLI for packaging and running agents with models, MCP tools, and subagents. [3,279 stars; local, self-hosted, containers, MCP, multi-agent]
- Flowise (https://github.com/FlowiseAI/Flowise): Visual builder and serving platform for agent flows, assistants, and tool integrations. [archived; 55,383 stars; self-hosted, managed, low-code, builder, tools]
- Langflow (https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow): Visual Python framework for composing and serving agent workflows with an API. [153,529 stars; local, self-hosted, managed, low-code, builder, API]
- LlamaDeploy (https://github.com/run-llama/llama_deploy): Deployment system for running agent workflows as scalable, event-driven services. [2,068 stars; self-hosted, event-driven, services, scaling]
- T3 Code (https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code): Local control plane for operating existing coding-agent CLIs from web, desktop, and mobile clients. [19,894 stars; local, self-hosted, control-plane, coding, remote-access]

## Sandboxes and execution environments

Isolated environments in which agents can safely run code, commands, and tools.

- Daytona (https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona): Secure infrastructure for programmatically creating and managing agent execution sandboxes. [71,932 stars; self-hosted, managed, sandbox, code-execution, API]
- E2B (https://github.com/e2b-dev/E2B): Open-source infrastructure for running agent-generated code in isolated cloud sandboxes. [13,506 stars; self-hosted, managed, sandbox, code-execution, API]
- Microsandbox (https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox): Self-hosted microVM platform for secure, fast, and isolated user or agent code execution. [7,841 stars; local, self-hosted, microVM, isolation, code-execution]
- NVIDIA OpenShell (https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell): Policy-governed runtime for running autonomous agents inside private sandboxes. [8,302 stars; local, self-hosted, sandbox, policy, privacy]
- SandboxFusion (https://github.com/bytedance/SandboxFusion): Execution service for isolated code evaluation across many programming languages. [1,059 stars; self-hosted, sandbox, code-execution, multi-language]

## Durable execution substrates

Agent-adjacent workflow engines used for retries, resumability, schedules, and long-running work.

- DBOS (https://github.com/dbos-inc/dbos-transact-py): Python durable-execution library for workflows that recover state and resume after failures. [1,539 stars; library, self-hosted, managed, durable, workflows, recovery]
- Hatchet (https://github.com/hatchet-dev/hatchet): Task orchestration platform for durable workflows, queues, retries, concurrency, and monitoring. [7,772 stars; self-hosted, managed, durable, workflows, observability]
- Inngest (https://github.com/inngest/inngest): Event-driven durable execution platform for step functions, scheduling, retries, and agent workflows. [5,752 stars; self-hosted, managed, durable, event-driven, workflows]
- Temporal (https://github.com/temporalio/temporal): General durable-execution platform commonly used to make long-running agent workflows resilient. [22,438 stars; self-hosted, managed, durable, workflows, recovery]
- Trigger.dev (https://github.com/triggerdotdev/trigger.dev): TypeScript background-job platform for long-running AI tasks with retries, queues, and monitoring. [16,084 stars; self-hosted, managed, durable, background-jobs, observability]
